mismatches.ai_location: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26066-26209 evaluate_counter_offensive. Docstring 26071 says it 'lets the AI fight next'. The score uses only melee/unit value/CHARACTER/wounds/model count. Use bar is at 26178 (best_score >= 3.0); 26190 says the unit 'fights next before more of it dies'. Called from AIPlayer.gd:1435-1463 with (player, eligible_units, snapshot) only, without the fight-sequencer state.
mismatches.engine_location: FightPhase.gd:2986-3019 (_after_enemy_has_fought_window offers COUNTEROFFENSIVE to the non-active player after EVERY enemy activation when it has 2 CP and a fight-eligible unit); FightSequencer.gd:305-312 (select_to_fight sets picker = the other player) and 249-276 (next_selection: the defender picks next unless it has no Fights First unit while the attacker still has one); FightPhase.gd:3610-3620 (on decline, the sequencer chooses the next picker)
mismatches.rule_ref: 15.12 COUNTEROFFENSIVE (2CP): 'your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04)'. 12.04: 'players alternate selecting one friendly Fights First unit ... If there are no Fights First units that are eligible to fight, move to the Resolve Remaining Combats step where this player will select their next unit. Otherwise, the other player selects their next unit.'
mismatches.ai_assumes: Spending 2 CP on COUNTEROFFENSIVE is what lets the defender's unit fight next; without it the unit can be killed before it fights.
mismatches.actually: After an enemy unit fights, the 12.04 alternation already gives the defender the next pick. The only exception is when the attacker still has an eligible Fights First unit and the defender has none, and only then does CO change the order. The AI never checks this. When the attacker has no Fights First unit left and the CO unit is the defender's last eligible unit, CO gives nothing in the engine or in the rules: 2 CP are wasted.
mismatches.decisions_affected: Custodes mirror: 3.23 USE_COUNTER_OFFENSIVE per game (224 bench records, c1ba348; evaluate_counter_offensive is byte-identical at HEAD). Of 151 CO uses in the available stdout logs (rollouts and smoke runs; some duplicates possible): 57 (38%) were followed by no further pick, or only by the attacker's non-Fights-First units, so they were pure waste. 36 (24%) had the attacker with no Fights First unit left while the defender still had units, so CO was worthless under 12.04 (the engine rewards it, see CO-02). 58 (38%) had attacker Fights First units left, which is real value. Example in godot2026-10-31T03.58.15.log: P1 Stormboyz fights, P2 pays 2 CP to CO Wazdakka, then the log says 'Still no eligible units - Fight step complete'. Orks mirror: about 1 per game.
mismatches.vp_effect: About 1.2 pure-waste COs per game, about 2.4 CP per game across both sides in the Custodes mirror. The saved CP goes to HI and re-rolls. Small positive (+0.1 to +0.5 VP, estimate, not measured).
mismatches.fix_sketch: FIX_CO_NEXT_PICK (0 = old). In evaluate_counter_offensive, read the live FightPhase.sequencer_11e. If sequencer.selectable_units(board, attacker, true) is empty, the defender already picks next, so DECLINE. While the engine bug CO-02 remains, decline only when the candidate is also the defender's only eligible unit. Failing-first test: the attacker's single charger has fought, the defender has one engaged unit, CP 4. Param 0 returns USE_COUNTER_OFFENSIVE; param 1 returns DECLINE_COUNTER_OFFENSIVE.

mismatches.ai_location: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26255-26433 evaluate_heroic_intervention. Docstring 26262 says 'We have a melee-capable unit nearby (within 6" of the charging enemy)'. The candidate score at 26330-26369 uses only unit value, CHARACTER and enemy value, with no distance and no charge probability. Use bar at 26382 (>= 2.0). Mode choice at 26404-26416 picks leap_to_defend whenever any enemy that charged is within 12", even when another enemy is within 6".
mismatches.engine_location: StratagemManager.gd:4331-4417 get_heroic_intervention_eligible_units_11e (a unit is eligible if a charged enemy is within 12" (4334, 4405) or any enemy is within 6"); ChargePhase.gd:3843-3866 (mode target picked, 1 CP spent before the roll), 3870-3899 (2D6, Into the Fray capped at 6), 4191-4203 (the HI fails if the target is beyond the rolled distance)
mismatches.rule_ref: 15.11 HEROIC INTERVENTION: 'TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units ... Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02) ... Leap to Defend: ... only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.' 11.04: charge targets must be 'within the maximum distance' (the charge roll).
mismatches.ai_assumes: 10e HI eligibility: the counter-charger is within 6" of the charging enemy, so the charge roll almost always succeeds. The HI value is unit value x enemy value. Leap is preferred whenever a charger is within 12".
mismatches.actually: At 11e the engine offers every unengaged unit that has a charged enemy within 12" (Leap) or any enemy within 6" (Fray). The CP is spent before the 2D6 roll, and the HI fails if the roll is less than the edge distance. P(2D6 >= d) is 58% at 7", 28% at 9" and 8% at 11".
mismatches.decisions_affected: Custodes mirror: 7.33 USE_HEROIC_INTERVENTION per game against 3.70 APPLY_HEROIC_INTERVENTION_MOVE per game (224 records), so about 3.5 failed HI rolls per game at 1 CP each. Stdout logs: Leap to Defend succeeded 125/287 (44%), median distance of failed Leap targets 9.5"; Into the Fray succeeded 84/105 (80%). Examples: Stompa Leap rolled 11 and failed; Blade Champion Leap rolled 9 and failed. Orks mirror: 2-3 HI per game.
mismatches.vp_effect: About 1.5-2 CP per game per side wasted in the Custodes mirror. Choosing Fray, or declining, when the Leap target is far gives more successful counter-charges per CP. Small to medium positive (+0.2 to +0.6 VP, estimate, not measured).
mismatches.fix_sketch: FIX_HI_CHARGE_ODDS (0 = old). For each candidate, find d_leap (closest charged enemy within 12") and d_fray (closest enemy within 6"). Compute p_leap = P(2D6 >= ceil(d_leap)) and p_fray = P(min(2D6,6) >= ceil(d_fray)) with _charge_success_probability. EV = score x p. Pick the mode with the higher EV, set hi_action.mode to it, and apply the 2.0/4.0 bars to the EV. Failing-first tests: only a charged enemy at 11" and no enemy within 6" gives DECLINE with param 1. A charged enemy at 11" plus another enemy at 3" gives USE with mode into_the_fray with param 1.

audit.consistent_notes:
Line numbers refer to HEAD e12e6e8. AIDecisionMaker.gd grew from 27,200 to 27,577 lines during the audit; I took copies of the audited files in /tmp/audit_strat. Data sources: 224 Custodes-mirror bench records (bench_data/ai_versions_11e_2026-10-29, commit c1ba348). Every audited stratagem function is byte-identical at HEAD (evaluate_counter_offensive, evaluate_heroic_intervention, evaluate_command_reroll_*, _evaluate_insane_bravery, evaluate_tank_shock, evaluate_grenade_usage, _estimate_overwatch_risk, evaluate_epic_challenge, evaluate_rapid_ingress, _decide_fire_overwatch_window_11e). I also used smoke runs at 7736b71 (/tmp/smoke_base, smoke_cust, smoke_orks), rollout stdout logs in user://test_results/rollout, and session logs. The real bench Orks fixture is Kult of Speed (Wazdakka, Stompa, Deffkoptas, Warbikers, Stormboyz, Gretchin). It is not the War Horde list in Orks_2000.json. No fixture has attached characters.

Assumptions checked and consistent:
- CP gain: both players get 1 CP in every Command phase (08.02; CommandPhase.gd:294-312).
- CP costs are read from the 11e definitions (_get_stratagem_cp_cost): Command Re-roll 1, Epic Challenge 1, Insane Bravery 1, Explosives 1, Crushing Impact 1, Rapid Ingress 1, Fire Overwatch 1, Smokescreen 1, Heroic Intervention (Leap) 1, Counteroffensive 2.
- The AI defers to can_use_stratagem for the 15.01 limits: once per phase, one stratagem per unit per phase, attached unit counted as one. Insane Bravery is once per battle. Rapid Ingress is not allowed in round 1.
- Stratagems cannot target battle-shocked units (01.07). The engine filters the HI and CO lists, the overwatch-risk loop skips shocked units, and Insane Bravery is blocked on shocked units at 11e, which matches the FAQ.
- A Command Re-roll on a charge re-rolls the full 2D6; on an advance it re-rolls 1D6.
- Insane Bravery is decided before the roll, as 11e requires.
- The 11e Fire Overwatch window decision is correct: end of the opponent's Movement phase, snap hits on 6s only, no critical hits, no re-rolls, 24". The engine excludes TITANIC units.
- The legacy 10e Fire Overwatch evaluator cannot be reached at 11e (MovementPhase.gd:1699-1702, ChargePhase.gd:607-611).
- Explosives math is correct (6D6, 4+ = 3 MW expected, 8", once per phase). Crushing Impact math in the AI matches 15.06.
- CO is offered only in the opponent's Fight phase (FightPhase.gd:2997). HI is offered at the end of the opponent's Charge phase, with 12"/6" mode targets and the Fray roll capped at 6.
- Go to Ground and New Orders are retired at 11e (edition_max 10). The AI code for them is dead but harmless.
- Smokescreen cover is valued as about -1 to hit, which matches 13.08 (worsen BS by 1).
- UNLEASH THE LIONS costs 1 CP in your Command phase, as in the 11e CSV row.
- Discarding a secondary for +1 CP matches docs/rules/11th_edition_missions_gdm2026.md:67.

Not verified, because these are mission-pack rules that are not in the core text: the 1-bonus-CP-per-round cap (GameState / AIDecisionMaker.gd:21363-21364) and replacing a drawn secondary for 1 CP.

Not reported: [TORRENT] auto-hits during snap shooting. The AI and the engine agree, and the rules text is ambiguous (15.09 vs 24.37). No save-roll Command Re-roll offers reached the AI in the sampled logs; that is a capability gap, not a mismatch.

Insane Bravery's 'on objective' test uses the marker radius (OBJECTIVE_CONTROL_RANGE_PX). This belongs to the OC auditor.

OW-01 is the T7-51 term found in earlier rounds, reconfirmed here because it is still not gated. HI-01, CO-01 and HI-02 are the highest-reach AI_vs_ENGINE items. CO-01 and HI-03 interact with the engine bugs CO-02 and HI-04, so fix the engine first or use the narrower fix noted in each fix_sketch.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:17374-17378 calls _estimate_overwatch_risk for every charger; 17461-17463 multiplies the score (term ch_overwatch_risk). No edition check and no FIX_ gate (the FIX_ consts at 1538-1726 have none for it). 18168-18265: the shooter loop filters only owner, alive, battle-shocked, 24" and has-ranged. The 18216 comment says 'not in engagement range' but nothing checks it, and there is no TITANIC filter. The multi-target EV (17840-17860) reuses these single-target scores, so the penalty carries into it. Engine: ChargePhase.gd:607-611 logs '[11e 15.08] no Fire Overwatch against charging' and makes no offer. StratagemManager.gd:172-175: CORE_WINDOW_STRATAGEMS has fire_overwatch_11e only in movement_phase_end. 5079-5093: its conditions are unengaged and not_keyword:TITANIC. 4197-4216 refuses TITANIC. MovementPhase.gd:1698-1704 makes no per-move offer. Rules: core_rules_11e.txt:1309-1315 (WHEN: end of your opponent's Movement phase; TARGET: line 1314 'unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units)'). git diff e12e6e8..HEAD on all audited files is empty. Real 11e overwatch does fire on the bench at the end of Movement (fx10_reach ork_94002: 6 FIRE OVERWATCH window uses; asy_99002: 4). So the charge-phase term prices again a risk that was already resolved. The movement term that would price the real timing is off: OVERWATCH_EXPOSURE_PENALTY = 0.0 at 2354, and _overwatch_exposure_penalty at 27117 also lacks a TITANIC filter.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Yes. It runs on every charge evaluation in all 3 fixtures. Standard-fixture logs: Custodes mirror has 86 and 183 [OVERWATCH-RISK] lines per game (mostly x0.96-1.0, with 8-21 lines at x0.49-0.86). Asym has 135 lines per game on the Custodes chargers: 25 'extreme' lines from the Ork Stompa (x0.13 or x0.34) and 41 from Deffkoptas (x0.35 or x0.55). In the asy_99002 record the term removed 18-39 score points from Custodes charges, which were still declared. Orks mirror: the standard record ork_94002 (rounds 1-3) has 1 DECLARE_CHARGE against 96 SKIP_CHARGE, and only 2 candidates carry the term (-3.05 and -0.18).
verdicts.corrected_description: The mismatch is confirmed, but the Orks evidence (92 lines, 86 'extreme', 3 DECLARE against 115 SKIP, 17 rejections, seed 92001) comes from the reserve-variant fixture mirror_orks_2000_reserves_postdeploy, not from the bench Orks fixture. On the bench, the clearest effect is in asym: Custodes chargers get x0.13-0.55 from the Stompa and the Deffkoptas. In decision records, multipliers are stored as additive score deltas (for example 'ch_overwatch_risk': -3.05). The failing-first test should therefore assert that the term is present and negative with param 0 and absent with param 1, not that it is '< 1'. The VP direction is not measured. STATUS 'Open follow-ups' says the evidence is that the AI already over-charges, so bench this fix in isolation.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26066-26209. The score uses only melee, unit value, keyword, wounds and model-count terms; the use bar is at 26178 (>=3.0) and the thinking text at 26190. It has no sequencer input. AIPlayer.gd:1435-1463 passes only (player, eligible_units, snapshot). Engine: FightPhase.gd:2986-3019 offers CO to the non-active player after every enemy activation. StratagemManager.gd:3710+ never checks who picks next. FightSequencer.gd:305-312: select_to_fight sets picker to the other player. 249-276: next_selection keeps the defender as picker unless the defender has no Fights First unit and the attacker still has one. Rules: 12.04 at core_rules_11e.txt:993-1003 (line 997) and 15.12 at 1343-1349. Bench cases where CO bought nothing: fx10_reach ork_94002 action 207 (P1 Stormboyz fights, P2 COs Wazdakka, then END_FIGHT); asy_99002 action 264 (Wazdakka fights, P1 COs Guard Beta, then END_FIGHT); cus_95002 action 149 (CO, then END_FIGHT); smoke_mirror_custodes_2000_postdeploy_s1 at 03:36:54 (CO on the last unit, then 'Fight step complete'); smoke_asym_2000_postdeploy_s1 at 03:41:20.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Yes. CO uses: Custodes mirror 3 in cus_95002 (rounds 1-3) and 3 and 2 in two full smoke games; asym 2 and 2; Orks mirror 1 in ork_94002 (rounds 1-3). Of 13 CO uses in standard-fixture data, 5 (38%) were pure waste at 2 CP each, and 8 came while the attacker still had Fights First units (real value).
verdicts.corrected_description: Confirmed. Refinement to the interim rule while CO-02 stands: CO is also worthless in the engine when the attacker has no eligible unit left at all. Example: in asym smoke at 03:41:20, P1 used CO, the engine let P1 pick again, but the attacker had no units left, so the order did not change. Decline when the attacker has no eligible Fights First unit AND either the candidate is the defender's only eligible unit or the attacker has no eligible unit at all. For the same reason, the auditor's 24% 'engine rewards it' bucket overstates the real engine benefit.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26255-26433. The docstring at 26262 says 'within 6" of the charging enemy' (10e). The candidate score at 26330-26369 is unit value x0.5 + CHARACTER/MONSTER bonus x enemy-value multiplier, with no distance and no charge probability. Bars at 26372-26391. The mode at 26416 is leap_to_defend whenever any charged enemy is within 12". Engine: StratagemManager.gd:4331-4417 makes a unit eligible with a charged enemy within 12" or any enemy within 6". ChargePhase.gd:3843-3866 picks the closest qualifying target and spends the CP (3862) before the 2D6 roll (3882). The Fray cap is at 3886. 4176-4203: the HI fails if the target is beyond the roll. Rules: 15.11 at core_rules_11e.txt:1331-1342 and 11.04 'within the maximum distance' at 927-931. Log lines 'HI target X" away is beyond the Y" roll' include 11.85>9, 11.64>8, 10.49>10 and 9.50>7 (all Leap).
verdicts.reaches_bench: Yes. Full standard games: 8 and 5 HIs in the Custodes mirror and 3 in asym, and 9 of these 16 failed (Leap succeeded 4/12, Fray 3/4). fx10_reach rounds 1-3: Custodes 4 HIs with 3 moves, asym 3 with 1, Orks 2 with 0 (both Stompa HIs failed). That is about 1.5-3 wasted CP per game.
verdicts.corrected_description: The mismatch is right. Note on the fix: the 2.0/4.0 bars were tuned on raw scores. Applying them to score x p raises the effective bar, so check the new decision rate with the V2-1 fix gate.

verdicts.evidence: Engine: StratagemManager.gd:4361 keeps VEHICLE units that are CHARACTER or WALKER, but ChargePhase.gd:3775-3788 (_validate_use_heroic_intervention) rejects every VEHICLE without WALKER, which is 10e wording. AIPlayer.gd:2640-2647 then declines the whole window. Rules core_rules_11e.txt:1336 'You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit', so Wazdakka is legal. In the bench fixture, Wazdakka has CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, MOUNTED, SMOKE and VEHICLE and no WALKER. The Deffkilla Wartrike has no VEHICLE keyword (it is MOUNTED), so it is a legal alternative. In the reserve-variant Orks smoke (seed 92001) there are 4 Wazdakka attempts, each followed by 'Heroic Intervention failed, declining instead'.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Orks fixtures only, and only now and then. There were 0 Wazdakka HI attempts in the 3 standard-fixture Ork games inspected: asym smoke s1, and fx10_reach asy_99002 and ork_94002, where the AI picked Stompa, Wartrike, Warbikers or Blade Champion. The reserve-variant Ork smokes had 4, 1 and 0 attempts per game, and the asym-reserve s1 smoke had 1.
verdicts.corrected_description: The root cause is an inconsistency inside the engine: the eligible list follows 11e, but the validator follows 10e. The auditor's frequency ('Orks lose most HI windows', 4 of 6) comes from the reserve-variant fixture, not from the bench. The AI-side fix should retry the next-best candidate (or the validator should be fixed). It should not copy the validator's VEHICLE test, because that would wrongly skip Wazdakka once the engine is fixed.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26528-26551 re-rolls when P(2D6>=Ld) >= 0.4, which is always true for Ld 6-8. It is called from AIPlayer.gd:1592-1596. Engine: CommandPhase.gd:1035-1076 offers the re-roll through is_command_reroll_available, and 1259-1274 re-rolls both dice. StratagemManager.gd:3645-3657 and the command_re_roll_11e definition at 5006-5013 (trigger after_roll) have no roll-type filter. Rules: 15.02 at core_rules_11e.txt:1243-1257. The WHEN list (line 1247) is Advance, Charge, Damage, Hazard, Hit, Save, Wound and number-of-attacks rolls. Battle-shock (leadership) rolls are not in it, and grep finds no FAQ exception. For multi-dice rolls the rule is 'select one of those dice to re-roll'.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Yes, in all 3 fixtures. Full standard smoke games: 2 (Custodes), 1 (Custodes) and 2 (asym) per game. fx10_reach rounds 1-3: Orks 2, asym 2, Custodes 0. That is about 1-2 per game at 1 CP each, and each one usually removes a battle-shock.

verdicts.evidence: Engine: ChargePhase.gd:4079-4091 ('Per 10e rules: Heroic Intervention does NOT grant Fights First'). At 4104, grant_fights_first is passed only for Selfless Service, and 1742-1753 does the same for attached characters. FightSequencer.gd:91-102 takes Fights First only from flags or abilities. Rules: 15.11 says 'Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02)' (core_rules_11e.txt:1337), and 11.04 AFTER MOVING says 'Until the end of the turn, each model in your unit has the Fights First ability' (line 939). The AI follows the engine: there is no Fights First term in either the HI or the CO value.

verdicts.evidence: Engine: FightPhase.gd:5201-5225 sets current_selecting_player to the CO player and calls sequencer_11e.mark_fought. mark_fought (FightSequencer.gd:375-383) does not change the picker; only select_to_fight (305-312) passes the pick to the other player. Rules: 12.04 alternation and 15.12 'it must be the next unit you select to fight' (core_rules_11e.txt:1349). Verified example in rollout/hd5e_b_f2/A_5001.stdout.log at 03:19:43-44: P1 uses CO, then the log says '[11e] Next: Player 1 picks in the remaining step' while P2 still had 2 eligible units.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Rare on the standard fixtures. In the 13 CO uses in standard-fixture data, the CO player picked again only once (asym smoke at 03:41:21), and the attacker had no units left, so it had no effect. A real double activation needs: the attacker has no Fights First units left but still has eligible non-Fights-First units, and the defender has 2 or more eligible units.
verdicts.corrected_description: Confirmed as ENGINE_vs_RULES. The auditor's rate ('36/151 (24%), about 0.8 per game') comes from a mixed pool of rollout and smoke logs and overstates the bench rate.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26271 reads hi_cp from heroic_intervention_11e (1 CP). The last-CP bars at 26372-26391 and cp_cost at 26396 use it for both modes, and into_the_fray is chosen at 26416. Engine: ChargePhase.gd:3862 calls use_stratagem(player,'heroic_intervention',unit_id) without the mode. StratagemManager.gd:5103-5111 sets cp_cost 1, and grep finds no mode surcharge anywhere. Rules: core_rules_11e.txt:1338-1340 '+1CP Into the Fray', and the 15.01 FAQ at line 1234 says an optional +1CP section gives 'an original cost of 2CP'.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Yes. Into the Fray is chosen about once per game: full smoke games had 2 of 8 and 1 of 5 HIs in the Custodes mirror, and 1 of 3 in asym.

verdicts.evidence: Engine: ShootingPhase.gd:5829 runs units_that_shot.append(grenade_unit_id), and 786 then blocks the unit with 'Unit has already shot this phase'. StratagemManager.gd:5033-5045 uses trigger 'instead_of_shooting'. 3268-3330 checks only the GRENADES keyword. AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:24415-24421 applies x0.3/x0.7. Rules: 15.05 at core_rules_11e.txt:1273-1283 (TARGET at 1278) has no clause that ends the unit's shooting, and 10.02 (line 848) defines 'eligible to shoot' as not yet selected to shoot. Explosives is a stratagem effect, not a shooting type.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Orks only. fx10_reach ork_94002: 3 grenades in rounds 1-3. Asym: 0-1 per game (1 in smoke s1). Reserve-variant Ork smokes: 2-5. Custodes: 0, because they have no GRENADES units. The EXPLOSIVES-keyword part has no bench effect: no bench unit has EXPLOSIVES.

verdicts.evidence: Engine: StratagemManager.gd:3915-3990. 3934 uses dice = mini(T,6) and applies no self mortal wounds. 3947 records usage as 'tank_shock', while _check_usage_restriction (1220+) compares the resolved id 'crushing_impact', so the once-per-phase cap is not enforced. The 15.01 per-unit check at 1032-1047 still stops the same vehicle from using it twice. ChargePhase.gd:1531-1573 offers it to VEHICLE only, and 1210 routes it to execute_tank_shock. AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:25964-25969 models 15.06. Rules: core_rules_11e.txt:1287-1296.
verdicts.reaches_bench: Low. fx10_reach asy_99002 has 'AI uses Crushing Impact with Wazdakka Gutsmek on Custodian Guard Beta (T8, 2.7 expected MW)'; the engine resolved 6 dice, about 2.0 expected mortal wounds and no self-damage. The asym smoke s1 had 0 offers. The Stompa (T14) can trigger it when it charges. The fixtures have no MONSTERs.
verdicts.corrected_description: In practice this is also AI_vs_ENGINE: the AI plans the 11e rule (T dice, self mortal wounds) and the engine resolves the 10e rule. For T8 and T14 both versions clear the AI's 1.0 bar, so the decision rarely changes.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26600-26603 keeps the last CP unless the round is 4 or later, and 26622-26627 adds +3 urgency in round 4+ and +1 in round 3. Engine: ScoringPhase.gd:585-587 calls _destroy_remaining_reserves at the end of round 3, and 955-991 exempts repositioned units (972). Rules: 20.04 at core_rules_11e.txt:1575-1577. Example in the reserve-variant Orks smoke (seed 92001), line 99853: 'Only 1 CP remaining and Round 3 - declining (save CP)'.
verdicts.reaches_bench: 0 on the 3 bench fixtures, because no unit starts in reserves. The only reserve units are Allarus placed in reserves by On Gilded Wings. They are flagged repositioned_to_reserves (CustodesDetachments.gd:1157) and are exempt, and the current late-game logic fits them. Rapid Ingress is evaluated about once per game for them (cus_95002: 1 USE_RAPID_INGRESS). This finding matters only on the reserve fixtures.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:26157-26169 calls _are_units_close(unit, other, 1.5), and 26211-26230 measures model centre to model centre. Engine: GameConstants.gd:30-31 sets engagement range to 2" at 11e. Fixture base sizes: Custodes 40mm; Prosecutors, Stormboyz, Gretchin and Mek 32mm; Ork bikes, Wazdakka and Stompa are large or oval.
verdicts.reaches_bench: It runs in every CO evaluation (about 1-3 per game), but the +1.5 term rarely fires. It could only flip a decision at the last-CP 5.0 bar.
verdicts.corrected_description: Two 40mm bases in contact are 1.575" apart (centre to centre) and never count, but a 40mm base touching a 32mm base is 1.42" apart and does count. So the term can fire against Prosecutors and Ork infantry; 'never fires for Custodes' is too strong. The term is still negligible.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:25288-25296 values only enemy attached characters, using _estimate_melee_damage(unit, char_unit) of the activated unit. For an Attached unit that is the bodyguard id. Engine: FightPhase.gd:5063-5078 gives [PRECISION] only to CHARACTER components. StratagemManager.gd:3605-3640 checks the attached components for CHARACTER. Rules: 15.03 at core_rules_11e.txt:1258-1264.
verdicts.reaches_bench: The code runs whenever a CHARACTER unit fights (fx10_reach shows 1-3 DECLINE_EPIC_CHALLENGE per game), but no bench unit has attached characters (attached_characters = [] in all 3 fixtures). The value is always 0, so the AI always declines. No bench effect.

verdicts.evidence: AI: AIDecisionMaker.gd:24768-24769 uses the printed Ld, although _effective_leadership_for at 24578-24600 already mirrors CommandPhase._get_effective_leadership. Engine: CommandPhase.gd:946-972 (attached-unit highest Ld, Huge Show-Offs, Madcap) and 1003-1012 (roll bonuses). UnitAbilityManager.gd:3744-3745: get_battle_shock_bonus returns 0, so the bench Stompa's 'Waaagh! Effigy (Aura)' adds nothing. Rules: 01.06 at core_rules_11e.txt:209 (the roll succeeds against any model's Ld).
verdicts.reaches_bench: Insane Bravery is used about once per game (fx10_reach asy_99002 and cus_95002). On the bench the effective Ld equals the printed Ld: there are no attachments and no active Ld modifiers. No decision changes.

verdicts.evidence: Engine: StratagemManager.gd:4596-4622 offers Smokescreen after targets are selected, and only for targeted SMOKE units. 5094-5101: the smokescreen_11e start_of_phase timing is not enforced. Rules: 15.10 at core_rules_11e.txt:1324-1330 (WHEN at 1328 is the start of the opponent's Shooting phase; the cover also covers screened units). Asym standard smoke s1 logs '- SMOKESCREEN: eligible units = [U_WAZDAKKA_GUTSMEK_A]' at 03:36:42, 03:38:06 and 03:41:37, but has 0 'Reactive stratagem opportunity for AI player' lines.
verdicts.reaches_bench: 0. ShootingPhase.gd:2932-2933 opens the defender's reactive window only for a human defender, so in AI-vs-AI bench games the AI is never asked. There are 0 AI reactive decisions in 4 bench logs, although each had 5-21 offers per game.
verdicts.corrected_description: The engine mismatch stands, but the auditor's reason for zero reach is wrong. Smokescreen IS listed as available for Wazdakka in bench games (3 times in the standard asym smoke). It never reaches the AI because AI-vs-AI shooting skips the reactive window for AI defenders (see the first missed item).

missed: ShootingPhase.gd:2932-2933 (with _is_player_human at 2957-2961): when the AI shoots (the atomic SHOOT path), the defender's reactive stratagem window opens only for a HUMAN defender. So in AI-vs-AI bench games neither AI ever uses a defensive shooting stratagem: not the core SMOKESCREEN and not faction enemy_targets_unit_shooting stratagems such as Kult of Speed SPEEDIEST FREEKS or Lions of the Emperor VIGIL UNENDING. Evidence: smoke_asym_2000_postdeploy_s1 logged 21 'reactive stratagem(s) available' lines (SPEEDIEST FREEKS 12 for P2, VIGIL UNENDING 9 for P1, SMOKESCREEN 3) and 0 AI decisions. The Custodes mirror logs had 11 and 5 VIGIL UNENDING offers and the Orks smoke had 6; none was answered. As a result, AIDecisionMaker.gd:25321 evaluate_reactive_stratagem and the Smokescreen scoring at 25677-25682 cannot run on the bench; they run only on the human-attacker path at ShootingPhase.gd:1618-1640. Kind: engine/harness vs RULES, the same for both seats, in every shooting phase of all 3 fixtures. It leaves CP free for CO, HI and battle-shock re-rolls, and it makes any defensive-stratagem fix impossible to measure on the bench.

CustodesCodexOther.gd:191-196 gives FURY OF THE EMPEROR a constant ai_score of 2.5, so the AI buys it at every eligible declaration. AIDecisionMaker.gd:17409 computes charge probability without the +2. Under 15.01 (core_rules_11e.txt:1213; engine StratagemManager.gd:1032-1047), using FURY also blocks a Command Re-roll on that unit's charge roll in the same phase, and the AI prices neither the +2 nor the lost re-roll. Evidence in smoke_base (mirror_custodes_2000_postdeploy) at 04:00:54: FURY on Allarus #5 (CP 2 to 1), roll 7+2=9 against 9.5" needed, FAILED, and no Command Re-roll was offered. Medium confidence. Uses: 0-4 per game in Custodes fixtures. This overlaps the charges topic (charge-separator mechanism (c)).
